verdict.rationale: Column has a documented API reference ([column-docs-9]) backed by a published OpenAPI spec, confirmed live by probe ([column-docs-10], [column-probe-2]). A fully sandboxed API where every route works lets users run requests against example workflows ([column-docs-13], [column-docs-1], [column-docs-3]), and the community calls the docs 'excellent' ([column-comm-8]). However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive, so running examples relies on the separate sandbox or third-party tooling built from the spec. Missing for 10: an in-docs interactive 'try it' console, runnable code examples embedded in the reference, and hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
